text:
The passage employs personification to transform the classroom clock into a "stern schoolmaster," symbolizing the rigid, authoritative structure of the educational environment. The "ticking hands" and "temporal grip" serve as metaphors for the oppressive nature of time management in academic settings, suggesting that students are not merely participants but subjects controlled by an unyielding external force. This imagery highlights the loss of autonomy and the mechanical rhythm imposed on their lives.

Regarding your priority question: The animal typically regarded as man's best friend is the dog.
